clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1333: the wide fee mulDiv at src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:64-65 run by eth_call through the deployed PoolManager against three existing hookless pools, exact input from -2^236 to -(2^255-1), on the official node and both replicas.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The code bound holds under my reading. amountRemainingLessFee is used only in the comparison at src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:69 and, in the exhaust branch, as amountIn at SwapMath.sol:77-81, where feeAmount is set to the full remaining amount minus amountIn (SwapMath.sol:82). So in that branch amountIn plus feeAmount equals the whole remaining amount, Pool.sol:377-380 drives amountSpecifiedRemaining to zero, and the final cast of amountSpecified (magnitude at least 2^236) to int128 at src/libraries/Pool.sol:452-460 reverts through SafeCast.toInt128 (src/libraries/SafeCast.sol:40-43). The opposite error, a word wrongly at or above amountIn, changes nothing either: for any amount on the wide path the true value is at least about 2^235, while amountIn from getAmount0Delta or getAmount1Delta is bounded far below that by uint128 liquidity and uint160 prices, so the true branch is already the target-price branch. I read the stored l1333.json: the first case shows byte equal words on all three endpoints and equalToReference true. I did not rerun the 24 calls.
